steps.code:
# Parse all notes to extract date and habit values.
import re

habits_order = None
rows = []

for note in all_notes:
    # Extract date from title: "Habit Tracking Log for 2023-05-17"
    m = re.search(r'(\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2})', note['title'])
    if not m:
        continue
    date = m.group(1)
    
    # Parse content lines after the header
    lines = note['content'].split('\n')
    # Skip the first line (header) and any empty lines
    habit_values = {}
    for line in lines:
        line = line.strip()
        if not line or line.startswith('#'):
            continue
        if ':' in line:
            habit, value = line.split(':', 1)
            habit = habit.strip()
            value = value.strip().lower()
            habit_values[habit] = value
    
    if habits_order is None:
        # Use the order from the first note (keys in order of appearance)
        habits_order = list(habit_values.keys())
    
    rows.append((date, habit_values))

print("Habits order:", habits_order)
print("Number of rows:", len(rows))
print("Sample row:", rows[0])
